# IMAP thread death and URL readiness have different wait domains

The main loop checks DeathSignalReceived outside the URL-ready monitor, briefly checks m_threadShouldDie under the death monitor, then waits for URL/idle readiness under the readiness monitor. UI TellThreadToDie sets the death flag under its monitor and signals readiness so the waiting thread wakes. Preserve both state protection and the wake-up route; setting a death flag alone does not wake a condition wait. This is static source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/imap/src.
